name: ntrip-orchestrator
description: M3 screening unlock & first pilots — GNSS RTK OEM/fleet correction orchestration

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ntrip-orchestrator/core && npm run build -w @ntrip-orchestrator/adapters && npm run build -w @ntrip-orchestrator/api && npm run build -w @ntrip-orchestrator/proxy
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/core/dist/vault.test.js packages/core/dist/policy.test.js packages/api/dist/smoke.test.js packages/api/dist/m2.test.js packages/api/dist/m3.test.js packages/api/dist/ops_upstream.test.js packages/proxy/dist/smoke.test.js packages/proxy/dist/failover.test.js packages/proxy/dist/load.test.js packages/adapters/dist/smoke.test.js
scripts.loadtest: npm run build -w @ntrip-orchestrator/core && npm run build -w @ntrip-orchestrator/proxy && node --test packages/proxy/dist/load.test.js
